summary.text: Michelle DuBois is a Democratic state representative from Massachusetts who has represented the 10th Plymouth District since 2015 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election after advancing from the September 1 Democratic primary.

paragraphs.text: DuBois took office in the Massachusetts House of Representatives on January 7, 2015.

For the 2025-2026 session, Ballotpedia lists her on the House Committee on Intergovernmental Affairs, Steering, Policy and Scheduling, Children, Families and Persons with Disabilities Joint, and Mental Health, Substance Use and Recovery Joint (vice chair) committees.
